_note: WP7 look gates (ci/look_metrics.py) and 2-up sheets (ci/twoup.py). Each scene: the shots tried in order (the first that exists is measured; a HUD-off one, `*-nohud-*`, is gated, a HUD-on one is measured inside the HUD mask and only reported), the gates, the golden today frame (native-metal 385e8a7, the tree before WP7, HUD on) and the concept panel. Ranges follow the user's blend (base «Кристалл» + horror's beams and deep darkness + frost's rime): frame median 35–50 (between crisp's 50–60 and horror's floor; the plan's frost-base swarmshot range 40–55 is printed next to it), the swarmshot gates of the plan (p95/p50 ≥ 3.6, specks ≥ 800, clipped ≤ 0.8 %, R−B highlights ≥ +25, shadows ≤ −10), near-black ≤ 30 % (horror's limit).

beacon._warm_note: R−B of the beacon's highlights is reported, not gated: it follows the effect on screen at the shot (+40 with fire, +9 with the cryo beam on two runs of the same tree)

punchin._median_note: a close-up: its median follows the framing (the lit deck around the squad fills the frame), so it is reported, not gated; the shot EV keeps the deck from going milky. native-vx-fix: contrast gated (p95/p50 ≥ 3.6, near-black ≥ 12 %) — native-metal 2d38dfd passed at median 66.7, p95/p50 3.31, dark 9.6 % under a grey veil (the effects' lights of a weapon firing near the lens; LightGrid.punchInFxLightCut)
